Cc: recruit@talentnow.com, priya.suresh@example.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jan 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Offer cadence & payband framing for Kernel Squad — Wave 3

Team —

Following up from the hiring sync: we have three finalist offers in Wave 3 for the Kernel Squad (2 infra-focused, 1 runtime systems). I want to lock the comp framing and cadence today so TalentNow can dispatch formal offers without losing momentum. Quick summary below and two asks.

Candidates (high level):
- C1 (infra SWE, strong ex-pool): target L6, retention risk; expects ~market+6
- C2 (runtime SWE, senior IC): target L5/L6 equilibrium, fast start window
- C3 (infra SWE, junior senior): L5 target, flexible start

Proposed framing:
- Offer cadence: send C1 on Mon 1/16 (accelerated), C2 on Tue 1/17, C3 on Wed 1/18
- Payband mapping: use L6 mid for C1 (exception request), L5 mid for C2/C3
- Signing bonus: only for C1 (time-limited) to preserve comp plan parity

Two asks: please reply with (A) approval or objections to the payband exceptions (C1), and (B) sign-off on the send cadence. I attached the comp justification PDF and the offer templates. If we need a higher band for C1, suggest we route to compensation for a one-off and approve before Monday EOD.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Talent Partner, Platform Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PR-Comp-Justification-wave3.pdf, offer-templates-wave3.docx

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Offer cadence & payband framing for Kernel Squad — Wave 3

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear summary. High-level thoughts:
- I agree we should prioritize C1 for an accelerated send given the retention signal.
- Before an exception, can you map C1 to our comp bands in band-mapping-table.csv (L6 low/mid/high) and show where the requested number sits vs. band midpoint? If it's within the top quartile we should be able to approve without exec escalation.
- For cadence, keep the stagger (Mon/Tue/Wed) but allow TalentNow to push earlier if they surface counteroffers.

Cc'ing Kim for comp exception guidance. Also we should loop the hiring manager (Jonas) in the next note for alignment on start dates.

Mark
Marcus Lin
Head of Infra & Kernel Systems
Redwood Inference

Jasmine / Marcus —

I've reviewed the comp memo and band mapping. Quick decision: approve an elevated L6 offer for C1 up to L6 high (one-off exception) given a credible counter and the critical infra skillset. Conditions:
- No changes to job level (still L6).
- Offer to include a 10% time-limited signing bonus (paid over 6 months).
- Recruiter to confirm candidate's concrete competing offer details in writing before we commit.

Attached: band-mapping-table.csv (annotated) and a short note with rationale. Please proceed with the proposed cadence.

Kimberly Park
VP, Talent & Comp
Redwood Inference

Attachments: band-mapping-table.csv

Thanks for the update — confirmed on our side. We will:
- Send the accelerated offer to C1 this afternoon (Mon timeline moved to today to preempt another inbound).
- Send C2 on Tue and C3 Wed per the stagger.
- For C1, recruiter notes the competing offer is a verbal at +8% from a hyperscaler; candidate has asked for an expedited counter. They accept the signing bonus structure.

We will attach the offer templates you provided and include a short note quoting the comp exception approval. Expect a signed acceptance window by 1/19 EOD if there are no further counters.

Best —
